I'm marking "Duchenne muscular dystrophy" as a SpecificDisease under guideline 1. The abbreviation "DMD" at 195-198 is also a SpecificDisease, since guideline 6 splits abbreviation definitions into their own annotated mentions. The later "DMD" at 278 in "five boys with DMD" gets the same label under guideline 4.

I'm treating every remaining "DMD" mention as a SpecificDisease: the one at 380, the one at 458 in "five boys with DMD," the one at 1151 in "tool for DMD," and the one at 1540 in "DMD and its milder allelic forms." I checked whether any of them could act as a modifier, but in each case DMD names the disease itself, so none of them changes the label.
